ac2_hook: before_tool_call (priority 100) asks the broker to authorize every Pantheon tool call and blocks on refusal, handler error, timeout, unreachable broker, invalid plugin config or missing host identity; execute() runs only for a call that hook authorized (single-use, bound to agent and session).
